facts.fact: Le N'Djam Post reports the minister inaugurated PMICE Phase I at Sarh (Moyen-Chari) on 20 December 2025; the project (EUR 175,106,916) includes a 1,200 km national fibre backbone, but the article does not say the backbone is lit.
